standing_for.name: \rho_{\infty}
standing_for.because: the vacuum settles where a neutral point's splitting exactly pays for what the meetings take. That is one equation in one unknown and it has one root that is not negative - so the density is FIXED by the rules rather than chosen, and it is the same on every lattice

standing_for.name: \rho
standing_for.because: and the density the line's own terms carry IS that settled one, everywhere the line is about the vacuum rather than about a source - so a law written in terms of the density can be written in terms of the rates instead

standing_for.name: F
standing_for.because: the facing factor is (1 - d^·j^)/2 and j^ is what the opposing population is doing on average. Alike in every direction, that is nothing - so a meeting in an undisturbed vacuum carries exactly a half, and the two limits it interpolates are one head-on and nought co-moving

steps.because: the rules, read as a line: every rule of the theory is a term, the reading having run each rule's program on a symbolic match and counted what it does to the population - what it makes, what it takes, what it carries, what a body puts in - so the line is what the rules come to as a crowd rather than a description of them. Everything a theorem of this theory stands on is a term of this line or a reading of one, so every premise below is read off it, and every derivation passes through it

steps.via: the scale is the vacuum's own growth
working: CREATION: fires at a free point, lights every way - the vacuum pulses, every other tick
EMISSION: a source moves or emits, so each move flips the parity, fore against aft
steady: the flips cancel; accelerating: they pile up, since the beginning
the age is one over the vacuum's growth, \frac{1}{t}
steps.because: CREATION fires only at a free point and lights every way of it, so the vacuum pulses: a point fires, its rays leave, and it is free again the tick after. EMISSION sends only on the ticks a source stands - it moves or it emits - so whether what it sends meets the vacuum's lit half or its dark half is a parity, and every tick it moves flips it, the opposite way fore and aft. At a steady speed the flips cancel; while it accelerates they do not, and nothing has cut them off since the world began: they have piled up over the age, one over the rate the vacuum grows at. Carried at what a heading keeps straight, that is a rate of its own - the scale an acceleration is measured against

working: the draw: 1 straight on against n_{f} folded
derivation.because: MOVEMENT draws a ray straight on at one against every fold its place holds, so what a heading keeps of itself a step is one over one more than the record - and far from every body the record is the settled one, half the lattice's ways. It is the share of a step that goes where it was going: the speed a carrier's heading is carried at

derivation.via: the record settled against the density
derivation.because: the record's line is linear in the record: a meeting writes a fold whatever l holds, a creation takes one off every way that holds one, and the more folds l holds the more ways it has to write them on. Where the record has stopped moving the line is nought, and it says what the record is at a density. It settles: the record's slope in its own line is what a creation takes back less what the extra way gives the meetings, and at the settled density that is below nought

derivation.via: the world grows at its frontier
working: at the frontier: MOVEMENT at 1 - \omega, one cell a tick
derivation.because: so what grows the world is the frontier alone: a ray with nowhere to step makes the room and steps into it, the same tick - a ray never waits. The frontier advances a cell a tick, so a world grown from a point is as wide as it is old, R = \bar{c}t, and its rate of growth is one over its age: H = \dot{R}/R = 1/t. It is not a constant: it thins as the world ages, a coasting expansion, and today it is one over the age

working: MOVEMENT grows at 1 - \omega: nought where every ray has room ahead
derivation.because: the growth ledger read where the vacuum has settled: every ray there has room ahead, so MOVEMENT grows nothing and no meeting leaves a point behind a vacuum ray. The empty vacuum grows no space of its own - there is no constant in these rules that thins nothing

a firing that makes a point no local held - behind a ray at a meeting, ahead of a ray with nowhere to step - grows the world by it, at its own rate, through its own gates, the count written on it. This is the room the world gains per local per tick: what it expands by
